title: What AI Agents Actually Do in 2026
summary: AI agents have moved beyond chatbot territory. Here is what they actually do now, how they connect to your tools, and why MCP became the standard.
before: You ask a question, get an answer. No memory between sessions, no ability to take actions or access outside systems.
after: The AI plans multi-step tasks, uses tools, reads from databases, and takes actions in connected apps - with your approval.

title: Open Source AI Models Are Closing the Gap
summary: Llama, Mistral, DeepSeek, and Qwen have gone from distant followers to genuine contenders. Here's what that shift actually means.
before: Open source models lagged 12-18 months behind GPT-4. Running them required serious hardware and expertise.
after: Top open models trade blows with the closed frontier on many benchmarks. Some run efficiently on consumer hardware.

title: Why Every Lab Is Racing to Build Coding Agents
summary: Coding assistants used to suggest the next line. Now they open pull requests. Here's why AI labs see autonomous coding as the killer app.
before: AI suggests code snippets as you type. You review each suggestion, accept or reject, and do the actual work of building features.
after: AI reads your issue, writes the code, runs tests, and opens a pull request. You review the finished work, not individual suggestions.
